name.en: Directorate General for Relations with Civil Society (Ministry of Interior, Turkey)

description.en:
All non-profit associations operating in Turkey should register with the Directorate General for Relations with Civil Society (Formerly the Department of Associations). 

During registration, they will be given a registration number.

access.onlineAccessDetails: An online information system is available via siviltoplum.gov.tr/ but only for registered organisations, not the public.
access.guidanceOnLocatingIds: Identifiers are provided to organisations when they first register. Ask the organisation to check their registration certificate.
